heading: Office of Cargo Security Policy

tree.heading: Establishment
tree.text: There is established within the Department an Office of Cargo Security Policy (referred to in this section as the “Office”).

children.text: coordinate all Department policies relating to cargo security; and
consult with stakeholders and coordinate with other Federal agencies in the establishment of standards and regulations and to promote best practices.

children.heading: Appointment
children.text: The Office shall be headed by a Director, who shall—
be appointed by the Secretary; and
report to the Assistant Secretary for Policy.
advise the Assistant Secretary for Policy in the development of Department-wide policies regarding cargo security;
coordinate all policies relating to cargo security among the agencies and offices within the Department relating to cargo security; and
coordinate the cargo security policies of the Department with the policies of other executive agencies.

notes.heading: Rule of Construction
notes.text: Pub. L. 109–347, title III, § 301(c), Oct. 13, 2006, 120 Stat. 1920, provided that: “Nothing in this section [enacting this section and section 1001 of this title] shall be construed to affect— “(1) the authorities, functions, or capabilities of the Coast Guard to perform its missions; or “(2) the requirement under section 888 of the Homeland Security Act (6 U.S.C. 468) that those authorities, functions, and capabilities be maintained intact.”
